# QR scan in the app opens the name dialog
### Fixed
- **Scanning the TV's QR code inside the app** ("Scan QR code on the device") now opens "Device found" with a name field right away, instead of only taking over the code and asking you to pick an existing device. If the code belongs to another server or has expired, a clear hint is shown.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
